question: In a certain code language, SPIDER is written as RNHBDP. How will QUESTION be written as in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

SPIDER is written as RNHBDP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01bfc98d782e2a3387c82346b7dbfe54aff0b205d680ee3983cfcf98c990bf18.png] 

QUESTION will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b339bca8686823d0d2469d19470150f344184db565383806b5428775f9608a1.png]
